rows.Bloom: Red, cream edges. Average diameter 4". Large, double (17-25 petals), ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 28" to 32" (70 to 80cm). Width: 1' to 16" (30 to 40cm).
